abate.definition: to become less intense or widespread

catalyst.definition: a substance or event that causes a change to happen more quickly

diligent.definition: showing careful and persistent effort or work

eloquent.definition: fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing

frugal.definition: sparing or economical with regard to money or food

hinder.definition: to create difficulties for someone or something, resulting in delay or obstruction

juxtapose.definition: to place close together for contrasting effect

kinetic.definition: relating to or resulting from motion

meticulous.definition: showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise

novel.definition: new or unusual in an interesting way

objective.definition: not influenced by personal feelings or opinions in considering and representing facts

pragmatic.definition: dealing with problems in a practical and sensible way

reliable.definition: consistently good in quality or performance; able to be trusted

serendipity.definition: the occurrence of events by chance in a happy or beneficial way

tenacious.definition: tending to keep a firm hold of something; determined
